title: Ecosystems and Food Chains
text: An ecosystem is a community of living organisms interacting with each other and their physical environment. Energy flows through an ecosystem via food chains, starting with producers (plants, which convert sunlight into energy through photosynthesis), followed by primary consumers (herbivores), secondary consumers (carnivores), and decomposers (which break down dead matter, recycling nutrients). Food webs represent the interconnected food chains within an ecosystem.
